card.name: Endings of medical condition names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical condition or diagnosis word, such as -emia, -osis, -xia or -age, as the word finishes. It also fires on 'Block' in 'Heart Block'.

modes.label: -emia / -ia endings
modes.description: Final piece of blood or body-state condition words like hypokalemia, bradycardia and hypovolemia.

modes.label: Other condition endings
modes.description: Final piece of other diagnosis words such as osteonecrosis, anorexia and hemorrhage, or the word Block in Heart Block.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Complete Heart<< Block>>: Procainamide should not be administered

card.writes: It favors words that continue a diagnosis phrase, such as followed, bilateral and -itis, and disfavors generic words like Medical or Health.
card.plain: It lights up as a medical condition name is being completed, like hypokalemia or bradycardia.
